note: Sight-singing step 2: the home chord as a tune up to the high Do, learned in the named stages, then a run from Sol down to Do timed to land as the 1st chord comes back. The backing track's chords are tokens counted the long way, key and tempo are moves (70 up to 90) in place of the old Key selector, and the {{?key}} line says what stays the same.

exercise.title: Do Mi Sol Do, then a run home
exercise.why: A run sounds finished when it lands on Do just as the home chord comes back, so you hold Sol through the other chords and time the run down to arrive on that bar.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. The tune climbs the notes of the home chord, Do, Mi and Sol, to the high Do. Sing along on the note names.
Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
Once the high Do lands without a slide, press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing the tune a cappella.
{{?key}}In another key the notes are new, and the tune still climbs the chord to the high Do.

cells.heading: Run home over the backing track

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the mic and the backing track start together. The backing track plays {{chord:I}}, {{chord:V}}, {{chord:vi}} and {{chord:IV}}, one bar each.
{{chord:I}} is the 1st chord of the key, built on {{1}}, {{chord:V}} the 5th, built on {{5}}, {{chord:vi}} the 6th, built on {{6}}, and {{chord:IV}} the 4th, built on {{4}}. Hold {{5}} while the chords go by, then run down through {{4}}, {{3}} and {{2}} to {{1}}. Sing it on "ah".
Practice until the run lands on {{1}} just as {{chord:I}} comes round again.
